callback_message: Installing BenchPress already seeded a `wg0` WireGuard Server and its `pool-wg0` Network Pool, so there is nothing to create here — confirm `wg0` reads **Up** and move on. Peers are handed out per bench later.
callback_title: Your VPN is already wired up
description:
BenchPress reaches every bench over WireGuard. `vpn_management` seeds the `wg0` server on install, so this step is a look, not a build.

If the status is not **Up**, fix the tunnel before deploying anything — a bench on a down tunnel is unreachable.
name: Check your WireGuard server
title: Check your WireGuard server
